name: MS8V2 8-channel passive mic splitter
notes: 1RU passive splitter: each of 8 balanced mic inputs feeds a direct output and a transformer-isolated (link) output, with a ground lift switch and a 0 / -40 dB attenuator per channel, and inputs linkable in pairs (1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8). Phantom power passes through from the direct side. No mains power. Check: which XLRs are on the front and which on the rear, and the depth.
